articles.title: Bryan Zaragoza: "Cuando me senté en la mesa pensaba que estaba en el FIFA"
articles.standfirst: El futbolista del Espanyol habló sobre su carrera y su futuro en el club catalán
articles.summary: El futbolista del Espanyol habló sobre su carrera y su futuro en el club catalán
articles.body: Bryan Zaragoza ha iniciado este año un nuevo capítulo en su carrera con el Espanyol, en el que busca encontrar su mejor nivel. Así lo ha expresado en el programa 'Què t'hi Jugues!'. Uno de sus mejores encuentros fue frente al Barça en 2023, en el que marcó dos goles y el Bayern se inclinó por su fichaje. "Hay gente que dice que solo soy futbolista por ese partido", afirma. Sin embargo, no pudo asentarse en Alemania, y ha ido encadenando cesiones, aunque no se lamenta por fichar por el club germano. "No creo que me arrepienta de ir al Bayern de Múnich. Fue un paso importante en mi carrera. Cuando me senté en la mesa pensaba que estaba en el FIFA. Veía a Neuer, a Kimmich. Yo vengo de jugar en lo mas bajo. Para mi fue un paso muy difícil. Tenia 20 años, nunca había salido de mi zona de confort, el idioma, el clima, entrenar a -15 grados. Entras en un equipo de nivel que en tu posición tienes a Musiala, Sané, Gnabry, Coman, que llevan ganado la liga 12 años seguidos. Creo que no era nada fácil, pero me ha hecho aprender mucho y nunca estaré arrepentido, al revés, agradecido al Bayern siempre", añadió. Un futbolista que nunca lo ha tenido fácil, ya que fue descartado por Málaga y Betis por su físico. "Me descartaron en muchos clubes. En el club de toda mi vida me descartaron porque decían que no tenía el físico suficiente para jugar en División de Honor Juvenil. Yo no tengo rencor con nadie. Yo he hecho mi trabajo y estoy donde estoy por mi", comentó. Sin embargo, tuvo posibilidades de fichar por el Barça. "Hubo una posibilidad, contactos", dijo. Cuando le preguntan si hubo alguna reunión se ríe y lo deja en el aire. Pero ahora encara una nueva etapa con el Espanyol. "En España no es fácil venir con mi salario y con lo que pedía el Bayern. Este año hemos enganchado una oportunidad buena tanto el club como yo. Yo he tenido que hacer un esfuerzo grande por venir, el club ha hecho también un esfuerzo enorme. Lo que quiero es buscar un sitio donde pueda ser feliz, disfrutar. Cuando yo disfruto es cuando rindo y sacó mi nivel", afirmó. Poco a poco, está volviendo a se mejor forma. "El primer reto es encontrarme, ser feliz y a partir de ahí viene todo. Cuando soy feliz y me divierto, nadie me puede parar. He llegado con un déficit importante de ritmo y entrenamientos, pero cada vez estoy mejor. Cuando yo esté, la gente lo sabrá", señaló. Sin embargo, sabe que es en España donde puede sacar de nuevo su mejor fútbol. "Creo que en España no damos el valor que la gente cree porque se habla de que en otras ligas hay mucho dinero, pero en España sobra la calidad. Te vas a otros países y solo ves físico. Los mejores jugadores del mundo ahora mismo son españoles", aclaró. Y es amigo uno de los mejores como es Lamine Yamal. "Es muy amigo mío, hemos estado de vacaciones juntos. Somos jugadores de tener poca vergüenza en el campo, driblar, hacer cosas que muchos no intentan. Y salvando las distancias, porque ahora Lamine es uno de los mejores o el mejor, pero creo que somos jugadores de ese estilo", comentó. Y Bryan ha aprendido de los mejores. "Mi ídolo y el mejor de todos para mí es Messi, pero me gustaba mucho Neymar", sentenció.

articles.title: Nacho Quintana señala el camino al Andorra: "Necesitábamos competir y ganar"
articles.standfirst: Confía en que el triunfo en Granada sea el punto de inflexión tras cinco derrotas seguidas y destaca el paso adelante del equipo en "el otro fútbol"
articles.summary: Confía en que el triunfo en Granada sea el punto de inflexión tras cinco derrotas seguidas y destaca el paso adelante del equipo en "el otro fútbol"
articles.body: El triunfo en Granada ha devuelto aire al Andorra después de cinco derrotas consecutivas. Más allá de los tres puntos, Nacho Quintana considera que el equipo dio un paso adelante en una faceta que había echado en falta durante las últimas jornadas: competir. "Nos hacía falta cambiar la dinámica y creo que una victoria fuera de casa en un campo como el de Granada nos ha venido muy bien", explicó el atacante, que puso el foco en los duelos y en "el otro fútbol". "Nos venía costando un poco ganar duelos, competir, y creo que estuvimos muy bien y dimos un paso adelante en eso", ha añadido. El cambio de dibujo de Carles Manso tampoco es, a ojos del toledano, la principal explicación de la reacción. "Estamos buscando cuál es la mejor forma de jugar. El equipo se sintió bien, pero también nos sentimos bien con el 4-3-3. Era una cuestión de confianza más que del sistema", aseguró. La prioridad, pues, era mucho más sencilla: "Necesitábamos competir, ganar y, a partir de ahí, seguir creciendo". Ahora espera que el Nuevo los Cármenes marque un antes y un después: "Ojalá sea un punto de inflexión y el equipo empiece a ganar de manera continuada". En todo caso, una de las tareas pendientes continúa siendo el balón parado. En este punto, Quintana ha reconocido su importancia después de los problemas sufridos en las últimas jornadas y ha considerado que el Andorra debe progresar en las dos áreas. "Es una parte muy importante del fútbol hoy en día y, si no estás bien ahí, te va a costar mucho más. Es una asignatura para mejorar tanto en ataque como en defensa", ha mencionado en este sentido. El siguiente examen será el Sabadell, un rival que Quintana ya conoce y ante el que espera otro partido exigente en el apartado físico. "Es un conjunto muy fuerte en los duelos. Se basa en ganarlos y en ser vertical", advirtió.

articles.summary: Sustituye a José Antonio Bolarín Sánchez, que tras 18 años en el cargo es ahora presidente de Honor de la entidad
articles.body: Juan Guillamón Álvarez asume la presidencia de ElPozo Murcia Costa Cálida FS tras una larga vinculación con la entidad y con el deporte de la Región de Murcia. Juan Guillamón ejercía hasta ahora como vocal de la Junta Directiva de la entidad, de la que forma parte desde 2008, por lo que conoce de primera mano el proyecto, su estructura y los valores que han acompañado a ElPozo durante todos estos años. Juan Guillamón toma el relevo de José Antonio Bolarín Sánchez, presidente del club desde la temporada 2008-09 y que, tras 18 años al frente de la entidad, ha sido nombrado Presidente de Honor de ElPozo Murcia Costa Cálida FS. Murciano y con una dilatada trayectoria profesional, institucional y deportiva, Juan Guillamón es ingeniero de Caminos, Canales y Puertos, diplomado en Administración de Empresas y máster en Periodismo Deportivo. A lo largo de su trayectoria ha sido diputado en la Asamblea Regional de Murcia, decano del Colegio de Ingenieros de Caminos, Canales y Puertos de la Región de Murcia, presidente de la Asamblea Regional de Cruz Roja de Murcia y presidente del Real Murcia SAD, entidad de la que también formó parte como consejero durante diferentes etapas. El nuevo presidente será presentado oficialmente mañana, jueves, en el Palacio de los Deportes de Murcia, en un acto que contará con la presencia de D. Tomás Fuertes, presidente de Grupo Fuertes.

articles.title: El doctor Ripoll avisa con la operación de Asencio: "Son lesiones de cuatro meses"
articles.standfirst: El prestigioso traumatólogo valora en MARCA las alternativas en la cirugía y aclara el tiempo de recuperación aproximado
articles.summary: El prestigioso traumatólogo valora las alternativas en la cirugía y aclara el tiempo de recuperación aproximado
articles.body: El doctor Pedro Luis Ripoll, director de la clínica Ripoll y De Prado, aclara para MARCA que Asencio afronta un largo periodo de recuperación que estará en torno a los cuatro meses. Y todo ello con la prudencia de una lesión complicada. El central madridista será operado este jueves de una fractura por estrés en la tibia derecha y Ripoll analiza las alternativas para su reparación. "Las fracturas por estrés mecánico son muy frecuentes en el mundo del deporte, obviamente. Se producen principalmente por fatiga ósea. Es decir, el hueso sufre una serie de microfuerzas, de microlesiones, que es incapaz de reparar convenientemente y a tiempo. Cuando este desfase se produce, aparece la fractura por estrés", apunta el prestigioso traumatólogo. "La lesión es pues una descompensación en los huesos que reparan la fractura con las cargas que generan una mayor dimensión de la misma. Además, influyen otras cuestiones, como puede ser el cimbreado de la tibia al correr y también otras que están relacionadas con el morfotipo, que es la estructura del aparato locomotor que distribuye las cargas. Si hay algún error en esta distribución de cargas pues se es más propicio a sufrir estas fracturas. El tratamiento de estas fracturas según el grado de las mismas puede ser desde la mera estimulación del foco, haciendo algunas microfracturas que luego pueden implementarse con algún tipo de célula mesenquimal que favorezca la consolidación, o más comúnmente con un enclavado intramedular que estabilice la fractura o una placa en una forma menos agresiva. Dependiendo del grado se aplica uno u otro procedimiento. Este tipo de lesiones están en torno a las cuatro meses de recuperación", apunta RIpoll.

En un comunicado emitido este miércoles, ambos clubes señalan que han tomado esta decisión "con el objetivo de reforzar el carácter social y solidario con el que nació esta iniciativa". Por este motivo, estudiarán la celebración del encuentro en una nueva fecha y en unas "condiciones que permitan acercarlo de forma más directa a la ciudadanía ceutí y potenciar su carácter benéfico". Tal y como trasladan desde el Betis, la idea, siempre que el calendario lo permita, es que el encuentro se dispute en Ceuta cuando sea posible. Los fondos recaudados a través de la fila cero se destinarán, como estaba previsto, a Cáritas Ceuta. En cuanto a las entradas ya adquiridas, el Real Betis procederá en los próximos días a la devolución de su importe de las mismas. En la nota, "ambas entidades lamentan las molestias ocasionadas, agradecen la comprensión de los aficionados y reiteran su voluntad de llevar a cabo un partido que se convierta en una auténtica jornada de convivencia, deporte y solidaridad entre las aficiones caballa y bética".

articles.title: With Chargers struggling, could Jim Harbaugh leap back to college ranks? It's complicated ...
articles.summary: If not for the thicket of complications, Harbaugh would potentially be a superstar candidate for several jobs.
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Chargers are 0-3, with enough tough games in front of them that Jim Harbaugh's job status could potentially be in question by the end of October.

Meanwhile, the college football coaching carousel is starting to heat up , with agents, athletic directors and search firms beginning to speculate about how the pieces might move around the chess board.

Those two colliding developments have put Harbaugh's name on the fringe of conversations around the college coaching cycle, though more in the form of a hypothetical.

As the candidate pool begins to form for jobs that may open, is it possible for Harbaugh to return to college football given an exit from Michigan following the 2023 season that left a trail of NCAA sanctions in his wake?

"If he gets fired and is available, somebody will look," one coaching search industry executive told Yahoo Sports. "It comes down to timing."

In an era when there's no sure thing as a slam-dunk candidate, the 62-year-old Harbaugh is one of only six coaches currently employed in either college or the NFL with a national championship.

After he left Michigan, the assumption was that he'd never return to college football given his age, his track record of NFL success and the twin NCAA infractions cases that consumed the final years of his tenure: One involving recruiting violations, the other centered on illegal scouting.

The NCAA's determination that Harbaugh failed to fully cooperate with both investigations led to some of the most severe penalties that can be applied to a head coach.

As a result, the NCAA slapped a 10-year show-cause penalty on Harbaugh that runs through 2038, as well as a suspension that would apply for the entire first season at any school that might hire him.

According to the NCAA Committee on Infractions decision issued in 2025, Harbaugh would be prohibited from any "contact or communication with football coaching staff members or student-athletes during the suspension period" and may not participate in any coaching activities "including but not limited to team travel, practice, video study, recruiting and team meetings."

But it's also one that could theoretically be overcome, if a school was desperate enough to hire him, either through litigation or a plan where an interim coach would be in charge for one year.

"He's a heck of a football coach," one power conference athletic director said. "I'd certainly vet him."

Sources told Yahoo Sports, however, that a potential Harbaugh candidacy might have an even bigger problem than the NCAA: Big Ten commissioner Tony Petitti.

In 2023, Petitti leveled a three-game suspension on Harbaugh after former Michigan staffer Connor Stalions' elaborate scheme to steal the signals of opposing teams blew up into a national scandal. After the tension that caused between the two parties during Michigan's CFP championship run, one Big Ten athletic director told Yahoo Sports it would be a "fascinating discussion" with the league office if another school in the conference tried to make that play.

"If you had to overcome NCAA hurdles to hire Nick Saban, it's probably worth those fights," the AD said. "Why invite that for [Jim Harbaugh]?"

Said a second coaching industry executive: "The Big Ten is going to really struggle with somebody hiring Harbaugh so that kind of eliminates a whole conference worth of potential jobs. The second thing is just the timing. He'd have to resign or be fired almost by Thanksgiving to get a college job."

And the Big Ten is one of the few places where a job might open that could actually make some sense for Harbaugh: Southern Cal.

With Lincoln Riley unquestionably feeling some heat after last weekend's 41-27 loss at home to Oregon , missing the CFP for a fifth straight year could ultimately be the impetus for a separation.

But there is no obvious, ready-made coach with ties to the West Coast and a track record of winning at the highest level of college football that would meet the standard of expectations for what a USC search might look like.

If not for the thicket of complications, Harbaugh would potentially be that superstar candidate. Despite his underwhelming return to the NFL, where he's gone 11-6 in his first two seasons with a pair of wild-card playoff losses, he is still the kind of big name that would reignite a college fan base. And in contrast to someone like Jimbo Fisher, another retread name popping around potential openings, Harbaugh actually succeeded in the early part of the NIL era, winning the Big Ten title at Michigan in each of his last three seasons.

"He's one of the few answers to the question of how could you guarantee an upgrade over Lincoln Riley?" the second coaching industry executive said. "It would have to be a situation like that. The chances [of somebody hiring Harbaugh] are less than 10% but more than 0%."

And even if Harbaugh were available and considered a coaching upgrade, a lot of administrators would rather just make a hire that looks forward rather than to the past.

"It's hard to say how he'd do in the current environment," another power conference AD told Yahoo Sports. "Not sure that risk is worth all the drama that would come with him."

articles.title: Bombazo: ¡¡¡Cristiano Ronaldo abandona la concentración de Portugal!!!
articles.standfirst: Tras las palabras de Jorge Jesus negando cualquier problema
articles.summary: Tras las palabras de Jorge Jesus negando cualquier problema
articles.body: Bombazo desde Dinamarca: Cristiano Ronaldo deja la concentración de Portugal y cogerá en unas horas su avión privado rumbo a Madrid. El capitán y gran mito de la selección lusa se marcha tras las palabras de su seleccionador sobre su ausencia en los partidos ante Noruega y Dinamarca. Un adiós tempranero a este parón de la UEFA Nations League (quedaban dos partidos) que puede ser el punto y final de CR7 a la Selección lusa. Una situación que se ha precipitado en cuestión de minutos poco después de que Jorge Jesus, actual seleccionador de Portugal y su ex entrenador en Al Nassr (con el que ganó la liga saudí), dijera que no había problema alguno con CR7. Es más, había firmado que entrenaría hoy en Copenhague: "Ayer no se negó a entrenar. Francisco Conceição no entrenó por lesión, ni tampoco Félix, porque intentábamos aliviar la fatiga, y Cristiano Ronaldo hizo trabajo de gimnasio. Entrenará hoy. Es el cuarto día, así que entrenará". Pero no. El capitán abandonó el Parken en una furgoneta negra de la Federación Portuguesa de Fútbol. Jorge Jesus, además, había confirmado una reunión con Cristiano ayer martes por la noche, pero dejaba claro que todo se había resuelto antes de la hora de cenar. Sin embargo, dejó muy clara su postura de autoridad al frente de la Selección: "Puedo prometer lo que quiera. Soy el entrenador. Soy el entrenador, le dije al jugador que no iba a jugar. Te pondré en el banquillo. Si te necesito durante 30 minutos, jugarás; si no, no. Ningún jugador me hará cambiar de opinión. Ni él, ni nadie en el fútbol. Ni ningún presidente. Jamás, absolutamente nadie". La Federación Portuguesa de Fútbol emitió un comunicado en el que confirma la ausencia de Cristiano del entrenamiento... pero sin dar ningún tipo de explicación: "Información sobre el entrenamiento en el Parkenstadion: João Félix se ha reincorporado al equipo. Francisco Conceição (no disponible para mañana) y Cristiano Ronaldo no entrenaron. Gracias". Todo empezó hace unos días, en Oslo. Concretamente durante el Noruega 1-2 Portugal de Nations League. Cristiano partió desde el banquillo y Jorge Jesus entregó la titularidad a Joao Félix y Gonçalo Ramos. Le salió bien pues ambos marcaron y el equipo ganó... pero empezó la crisis. El capitán luso permaneció en el banquillo durante todo el partido, salvo los momentos de la segunda parte en los que estuvo calentando... pero se quedó sin minutos. Tras la victoria, CR7 se dirigió inmediatamente al vestuario y no se unió a los demás suplentes en el entrenamiento del día siguiente. Algo que justificó Jorge Jesus hace unas horas como algo "habitual" en el de Madeira. Pero lo que levantó todas las alarmas en Portugal fue el cambio de planes y viaje de Pedro Proença, presidente de la Federación Portuguesa de Fútbol, para reunirse en Copenhague con el astro luso y el seleccionador Jorge Jesus. Una reunión que tuvo lugar este miércoles por la mañana.

articles.title: Klopp se defiende tras la derrota ante Grecia
articles.standfirst: "Vamos a formar un equipo capaz de plantar cara a cualquier rival", dice el seleccionador de Alemania
articles.summary: "Vamos a formar un equipo capaz de plantar cara a cualquier rival", dice el seleccionador de Alemania
articles.body: El seleccionador de Alemania, Jürgen Klopp, defendió este miércoles su trabajo y el del combinado germano, que todavía no conoce la victoria desde que él tomó las riendas del equipo y que este jueves se mide a Serbia en Múnich, en un duelo del Grupo A2 de la Liga de Naciones. "Vamos a formar un equipo capaz de plantar cara a cualquier rival", dijo Klopp en la rueda de prensa previa al duelo del jueves, después del empate 1-1 registrado en Ámsterdam ante Países Bajos en el primer partido de la presente edición de la Liga de Naciones, y tras la derrota por 0-1 frente a Grecia en Augsburgo. "Hemos puesto en aprietos a nuestros dos primeros rivales en sus momentos clave. Eso es algo que quizá ahora no se valore demasiado", apuntó el seleccionador alemán, que llegó al cargo el pasado mes de julio. El entrenador, además, pidió paciencia ante los procesos de cambio que vive el equipo, especialmente para los jugadores. "Tener paciencia en este proceso también significa que no evaluamos a los jugadores de inmediato", aseveró. "También tenemos que darles ese tiempo a los chicos", sostuvo Klopp, que subrayó que tanto el empate ante Países Bajos como la derrota contra Grecia se produjeron por goles encajados en los últimos compases de esos partidos. El griego Dimitris Kourbelis marcó el tanto del 0-1 en Augsburgo que dio la victoria a Grecia frente a Alemania en el minuto 74. El neerlandés Cody Gakpo, por su parte, empató el partido en Ámsterdam en el minuto 93, después de que Felix Nmecha marcara el primer tanto de la era Klopp y abriera el marcador en la primera parte (m.32).

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal boss Jorge Jesus denies rift with captain
articles.summary: Portugal head coach Jorge Jesus says there is no rift with captain Cristiano Ronaldo following claims the five-time Ballon d'Or winner had refused to train.
articles.body:
Portugal head coach Jorge Jesus has said there is no rift with captain Cristiano Ronaldo following claims the five-time Ballon d'Or winner had refused to train.

The Al-Nassr forward did not feature in Portugal's 2-1 win over Norway in Olso on Sunday and did not join his team-mates in going over to the visiting fans at the final whistle.

Instead, the former Real Madrid and Manchester United player headed to the changing rooms - prompting reports he was unhappy with the manager.

Speaking to media before Portugal's Nations League match against Denmark on Thursday, Jesus said: "There was no incident whatsoever.

"Any player - and I was a player myself - when you spend 20 or 30 minutes warming up and then don't get on, no-one is happy about that."

Jesus said he had told Ronaldo before the match he would not be starting, but might be brought on later in the game.

"Afterwards, as coach, I decided not to bring him on. It's nothing to make a fuss about," he added.

Former Benfica manager Jesus also dismissed suggestions Ronaldo had refused to train on Tuesday, saying the 41-year-old instead had to do individual exercises for "mobility" and "strengthening" but would train as normal on Wednesday.

However, Ronaldo did not join his team-mates on the pitch in Denmark with Portuguese media sharing a video of him leaving Parken stadium alongside two members of the backroom staff.

They also said Ronaldo's private jet was heading to Copenhagen.

Goncalo Ramos scored the winner against Norway and Jesus confirmed the AC Milan striker would again be preferred to Ronaldo against Denmark.

"If everything goes according to plan, it will be Goncalo who plays," Jesus said.

"If I need [Ronaldo], he'll come on. If I don't need him, he won't."

articles.title: El Barça de Caro conquista Roma
articles.standfirst: Set azulgrana en feudo romano con goles de Graham (2), Pina (2), Pajor y Oladipo en propia puerta
articles.summary: Set azulgrana en feudo romano con goles de Graham (2), Pina (2), Pajor y Oladipo en propia puerta
articles.body: El Barcelona sumó una nueva victoria en el arranque de curso, esta vez con la Roma como rival (0-6) y el Stadio Tre Fontane como escenario de juego. Los goles de Graham (2), Pina (2), Pajor y Oladipo en propia puerta hacen sumar tres puntos más a las azulgrana en esta fase Liga que ya lideran con solvencia. Las visitantes llevaron la batuta del partido desde el pitido inicial. No tardaron en encerrar a una Roma que parecía cómoda aguantando en bloque bajo intentando salir a la contra. Escenario conocido para el Barcelona, que maduró el balón sabiendo que las ocasiones no tardarían en llegar. El primer aviso lo dio Brugts, rematando de primeras un pase desde el costado diestro de Graham. Fue la noruega quien abriría la lata poco después en una jugada de videojuego arcade, cogiendo el balón en línea de tres cuartos, conduciéndolo a la par que sorteaba rivales y definiendo una vez pisó el área rival. Abierta la lata, la sensación fue que el Barcelona no tardaría en ampliar su renta. El disparo de Brugts desde la frontal se fue lamiendo el poste y el remate a bocajarro de Schertenleib tras la salida de un córner se estrelló en el cuerpo de la meta rival. Llegaría a cinco minutos para el descanso, tras un intento de pared entre Pina y Graham que acabó con Oladipo metiéndose el balón en su propia portería. La Roma intentó reaccionar, pero más allá de un par de disparos lejanos de Giugliano poco más hubo que reseñar. El Barcelona, por su parte, sentenció el choque en siete minutos tras la reanudación. Primero anotó Pina, que recibió un pase de Pajor para internarse en el área, quebrar a su marca y batir por bajo a Baldi. Luego fue Graham quien aprovechó un balón filtrado de Serrajordi para plantarse ante la meta italiana y definir con una picadita con mucha clase. Romeu aprovechó la coyuntura para dosificar esfuerzos. Dio entrada a Bonmatí y Camara primero y a Julià, Rosalía y Van Asten después. Pina hizo la manita con un potente disparo desde la frontal que hizo una parábola que sorprendió a Baldi. El broche lo puso Pajor, que cerró una buena jugada colectiva que arrancó con un centro de Guijarro, la asistencia con la testa de Van Asten y la pegada de la polaca.

articles.body: Mientras su jet privado vuela a Copenhague y él espera en Dinamarca para volar a Madrid, Cristiano Ronaldo emitió un comunicado sobre su decisión de abandonar la concentración de la Selección de Portugal en la víspera del partido de Nations League contra Dinamarca. A su debido tiempo contaré la verdad a todos los portugueses sobre las razones que me motivaron a dejar la Selección a la que siempre me dediqué. articles.summary: Golea al Hearts, firma la primera victoria del curso y se mete en octavos de la Women's Europa Cup
articles.body: La Real Sociedad se clasificó para los octavos de final de la Women's Europa Cup tras superar al Hearts, a quien se impuso (4-0) en Zubieta. articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo statement after leaving the Portugal camp due to bust-up with Jorge Jesus: ‘In due time, I will tell the truth’
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has broken his silence after leaving Portugal’s training camp early, saying he will reveal the truth behind his decision in due time.The Al...
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo has broken his silence after leaving Portugal 's training camp early, saying he will reveal the truth behind his decision in due time.

The Al-Nassr forward issued a statement after Portugal manager Jorge Jesus' latest press conference and a conversation with Portuguese Football Federation president Pedro Proenca.

"Following the national team manager's press conference, and after a conversation with the President of the Portuguese Football Federation, I have decided to leave the national team camp," Ronaldo said .

"In due course, I will tell all Portuguese people the truth about the reasons that led to my departure from the national team, to which I have always been fully committed."

Ronaldo added: "For now, it is time to wish Portugal and all my teammates, without exception, the very best of luck."

His decision comes due to tension following his omission from Portugal's starting XI for their Nations League clash with Norway .

Jesus started Joao Felix and Goncalo Ramos up front, and both players scored in the 2-1 victory, while Ronaldo remained on the bench despite warming up in the second half.

The 41-year-old went straight to the dressing room after the final whistle. He didn't greet the travelling supporters, further fuelling speculation about his relationship with the new Portugal boss.

Jesus insisted there was no personal disagreement, explaining that he had already told Ronaldo on Tuesday that he might not play in their upcoming game against Denmark .

"I told the player he wasn't going to play," Jesus said. "If I need you for 30 minutes, you'll play; if not, you won't. No player will make me change my mind."

The Portuguese FA president subsequently travelled to Copenhagen for a meeting involving Jesus and Ronaldo.

Ronaldo has scored 146 goals in 234 appearances for Portugal.

Ronaldo has 979 goals in 1,338 appearances across a remarkable 23-year professional career. He remains focused on reaching 1,000 career goals.

articles.title: Manchester City charges: Punishment before end of season, Premier League clubs believe
articles.summary: Manchester City's punishment for breaching Premier League rules should be handed down before the end of this season, senior football figures tell BBC Sport.
articles.body:
Manchester City 's punishment for breaching Premier League rules should be handed down before the end of this season, senior football figures have told BBC Sport.

The Premier League said on Tuesday that City had been found guilty of all charges relating to breaches of its financial regulations between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 seasons.

They included artificially inflating revenue by more than £900m through "sham" sponsorship deals.

City have repeatedly denied guilt and signalled an intent to lodge an appeal by the end of this week.

There have been fears that the process, which has taken three years since City were charged, could be drawn out for much longer.

However, senior figures within football have told BBC Sport they see no reason why the case cannot be concluded by the end of this season.

Speaking on condition of anonymity, one club official said: "It benefits everyone for this to be resolved as quickly as possible."

When asked if they believed it would be, they said: "Instinctively yes, but it has to be done right.

"We can all see what the risks are if it's not. But those risks have been there throughout the process, as they've won the league multiple times during it."

Criminal investigation? Relegation or expulsion? The key Man City questions

Guardiola backing Man City after guilty verdicts

Burnham 'really concerned' if Man City owners sell up after rule breaches

Another source said the process "should" be resolved by the end of the season, and they hoped any appeal would be "compressed".

The final decision rests in the hands of the independent commission, with the Premier League board - and City - able to suggest a suitable punishment before the panel makes its decision.

There is increasingly a desire to have the case resolved by the end of the season amid fears that allowing City to get to the end of the campaign without punishment could lead to uncertainty and farce, particularly if they were to win the title.

One section of the Premier League regulations says an appeal should conclude no more than 12 weeks after it is filed, and a decision should be made within 30 days of its end.

Procedures can be hurried to meet certain deadlines, like the end of a league season.

However, Ferran Soriano, the club's chief executive, has suggested the case will run for a long time.

Manchester City cannot make a further appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (Cas), but could potentially claim the process was not impartial at the High Court.

The Premier League's statement, formally announcing the guilty verdicts read on Monday, said it wants the process to be "concluded as soon as possible".

articles.title: Antonio Lappí reaparece: "Si me dan la oportunidad, no la voy a desaprovechar"
articles.standfirst: El empresario sevillano es la cara visible de la conocida Tercera Vía
articles.summary: El empresario sevillano es la cara visible de la conocida Tercera Vía
articles.body: El Sevilla terminó la temporada pasada en la decimoséptima posición liguera, a tan solo un punto del descenso. El curso fue complicado y la actualidad deportiva se cruzaba con los rumores relacionados con la posible venta del club. Antonio Lappí, que encabeza la denominada Tercera Vía, dio un paso al frente y presentó una oferta formal a las grandes familias de accionistas del Sevilla. "Muy valiente, demasiado valiente, porque estamos hablando de más de 320 millones de euros", dijo a finales de 2025. La última negociación conocida, y mediática, fue con el grupo de Sergio Ramos. Una compra frustrada que terminó con un duro comunicado de los accionistas y una rueda de prensa convocada por el camero para ofrecer su versión. La venta del club blanquirrojo, sujeta esta vez a los parámetros de seguridad de Goldman Sachs, principal acreedor de la entidad nervionense, sigue abierta. Coincidiendo con el parón de selecciones ha reaparecido en escena Antonio Lappí. El empresario sevillano ha hablado y aunque no será hasta este jueves cuando se conozca su entrevista completa en el espacio Compagio Podcast, en un avance deja clara su postura: "Yo pienso que el Sevilla... Algunas veces me da hasta pena de lo mediocres que somos en lo que se refiere a la ambición. Están recortando gastos. Esto no anda para adelante, así no anda. A mí, si me dan la oportunidad, créeme que no la voy a desaprovechar". "Yo sé lo que tendría que hacer. Y yo sé con quién tengo que ir. Yo tengo nombre y apellidos", comenta antes de comparar la situación del Sevilla con el Real Madrid. "Ellos compran el nueve y hacen marketing. Nosotros tenemos que hacer marketing para ver si compramos un nueve", apunta el empresario sevillano.

articles.title: Ronaldo leaves Portugal training camp after coach says he is dropped
articles.summary: Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo announced on Wednesday that he had left the team's training camp in Denmark after coach Jorge Jesus told reporters that th...
articles.body:
Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo announced on Wednesday that he had left the team's training camp in Denmark after coach Jorge Jesus told reporters that the striker would be dropped for their next match.

Ronaldo had been due to train with his team-mates at the Parken stadium in Copenhagen on Wednesday but left abruptly after Jesus's press conference.

The veteran coach had said that Ronaldo, who spent the entire match on the bench against Norway on Sunday, would not start Thursday's Nations League clash away to Denmark either.

"Following the national team coach's press conference, and after having a conversation with the Portuguese Football Federation president, I decided to leave the national team's training camp," Ronaldo wrote on Instagram.

"In due course, I will tell the truth to all the Portuguese people about my reasons for leaving the national team, to which I have always been dedicated.

"Now is time to wish good luck to Portugal and to all my team-mates, without exception."

Jesus had insisted earlier that there was no rift between him and Ronaldo, although the 72-year-old did acknowledge that his captain had been disappointed to remain on the bench in the side's Nations League win over Norway.

Following the 2-1 victory in Oslo, Ronaldo went straight to the changing rooms without joining his team-mates in acknowledging the Portuguese supporters in the stands.

"There was no incident whatsoever," Jesus told reporters.

"Any player –- and I was a player myself... when you spend 20 or 30 minutes warming up and then don't get on... no one is happy about that," Jesus said on Wednesday.

The Portuguese coach added that he had told Ronaldo before the match that he would not be in the starting line-up, but that he might bring him on towards the end of the game.

"Afterwards, as coach, I decided not to bring him on. It's nothing to make a fuss about," Jesus insisted.

The former Benfica boss also explained that Ronaldo had not refused to train on Tuesday, as some Portuguese media outlets had suggested, but that he had had to do individual exercises for physical "mobility" and "strengthening".

Jesus had said that the five-time Ballon d'Or winner would train as normal on Wednesday, however, despite arriving at the stadium in the team bus, Ronaldo did not join his team-mates on the pitch in Copenhagen.

Portuguese media shared a video of him leaving the Parken stadium alongside two members of the backroom staff just after Jesus's press conference.

They also said that Ronaldo's private jet was heading to Copenhagen.

Just before Ronaldo's social media post, the Portuguese federation had released a brief statement merely confirming that the former Real Madrid , Manchester United and Juventus player had not trained.

Jesus had said earlier that for the Denmark match he again intended to start AC Milan striker Goncalo Ramos, who scored the winner against the Norwegians.

"If everything goes according to plan, it will be Goncalo who plays," he said, before adding regarding Ronaldo: "If I need him, he'll come on. If I don't need him, he won't."

At 41, Ronaldo announced this summer that this season would "probably (be) my last year in football".

He is Portugal's leading goalscorer and most capped player, with 146 goals in 234 appearances.

articles.title: Gianni Infantino loses support of his home nation Switzerland for FIFA presidential campaign
articles.summary: European soccer body UEFA has led calls to remove its long-time former employee Infantino either before or at the FIFA election in March, because of his fail...
articles.body:
BERN, Switzerland (AP) — Gianni Infantino formally lost support from his home nation Switzerland on Wednesday for the FIFA presidential election next year over concerns for the integrity of the world soccer body.

European soccer body UEFA has led calls to remove its long-time former employee Infantino either before or at the FIFA election in March, because of his failed proposal to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors.

The Swiss federation also cited concern Wednesday for the integrity of competitions after pressure from U.S. President Donald Trump not to impose a mandatory one-game ban on the World Cup co-host nation's forward Folarin Balogun from a round of 16 game against Belgium earlier this year.

Citing the need for credibility, transparency, accountability and effective statutory bodies, the Swiss federation said they were "essential to have trust in the governance of international football and in the integrity of FIFA."

These conditions were no longer fulfilled since June when it first pledged support for Infantino, the Swiss federation said.

Infantino had seemed set to win a fourth and final term in office through 2031 unopposed until his secretive plan to create a commercial subsidiary company was revealed by media reports on July 28. The plan was dropped within days amid a global backlash.

UEFA is set to meet with its 55 member federations next week in Berlin to work toward finding a candidate to challenge Infantino by a Nov. 18 deadline to enter the contest. The vote by 211 FIFA member federations is on March 18 in Rabat, Morocco.

articles.title: Real Betis star in/Atlético Madrid star out: Spain announce latest Nations League squad change
articles.summary: The Spanish national team have on Wednesday announced a fresh change to the country’s squad for their remaining Nations League fixtures over the days ahead.T...
articles.body:
The Spanish national team have on Wednesday announced a fresh change to the country's squad for their remaining Nations League fixtures over the days ahead.

The change in question comes at the back, where Alejandro Grimaldo has been forced to drop out of Luis de la Fuente's setup owing to a fitness complaint.

Left-back Grimaldo was an unused substitute in Spain 's victories over both England and Croatia over the last week, with De La Fuente and his staff having instead opted for Marc Cucurella .

The Atlético Madrid summer signing was expected to be afforded at least some minutes in La Roja's remaining two fixtures during the break, with rotation incoming in the world champions' XI.

But as alluded to above, for Grimaldo at least, this will not prove to be the case…

As per a statement across Spain's social media platforms on Wednesday, the 31-year-old has picked up a thigh problem, therefore replaced by Real Betis ' Fran García in the country's camp:

'Fran García, a player for Real Betis Balompié, replaces Alejandro Grimaldo in the Spain squad, which is currently playing in the UEFA Nations League and still has two matches remaining in this window.

'The Atlético de Madrid international defender felt some discomfort in his left thigh during the warm-up before the Spain – Croatia match at the Sánchez-Pizjuán stadium and, after the tests carried out, he is leaving the national team camp as a precaution, thus avoiding any added risk and preserving the player's health.'

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo leaves Portugal team amidst spat with manager
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo was expected to get along with new Portugal manager Jorge Jesus, but instead has departed from camp after a spat with the coach.
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo has left the Portugal national team halfway through the international window with UEFA Nations League games against Denmark and Norway still to come.

The 41-year-old, who has suited up for Portugal 234 times and is the country's all-time leading scorer with 146 goals, was an unused substitute in the Seleção's 2-1 win over Norway on Sunday, Sept. 27.

That reportedly sparked frustration with Ronaldo, who had been an unused substitute just twice times before in his Portugal career, once in a dead rubber in Euro 2008 and once in a pre-tournament friendly before Euro 2024. Portugal's major sports newspapers reported a 'crisis meeting' between Ronaldo and the coaching staff.

"Don't try to make a fuss where there isn't one. It was a coach's decision, I had a plan," he told reporters at a news conference.

Cristiano Ronaldo ends World Cup career as Spain defeats Portugal

After that news conference, however, Ronaldo said he spoke with Portuguese Football Federation president Pedro Proença and has made his decision to leave.

"After the national team coach's press conference, and after a conversation with the President of the Portuguese Football Federation, I made the decision to leave the national team's training camp," he wrote on Instagram. "In time, I will tell the truth to all Portuguese people about the reasons behind my departure from the national team, which I have always dedicated myself to."

Jesus and Ronaldo have a long working relationship, with Jesus taking over Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia in part because of his familiarity with the former Real Madrid and Manchester United star. Ahead of the September matches, both men expressed optimism about Ronaldo's role with the team .

"They count on me. I still believe that I'm able to help the national team," Ronaldo said. "The most important point is to be able, inside the pitch, to score goals and help the team to win games."

Jesus will now look to win the next two matches without Ronaldo, preparing his side for the Oct. 1 game in Denmark and a home match against Norway on Oct. 4 with the remaining members of the Portugal team.

What did Cristiano Ronaldo's Instagram post about the Portugal national team say?

"After the national team coach's press conference, and after a conversation with the President of the Portuguese Football Federation, I made the decision to leave the national team's training camp," the statement read. "In time, I will tell the truth to all Portuguese people about the reasons behind my departure from the national team, which I have always dedicated myself to.

"Now is the time to wish good luck to Portugal and to all my teammates, without exception."

articles.title: Leah Williamson gives away calamitous penalty as Arsenal throw away two-goal lead to draw with Paris FC in Women's Champions League
articles.summary: Leah Williamson conceded a late penalty as Arsenal threw away a 2-0 lead to draw 2-2 with Paris FC; Alessia Russo and Georgia Stanway had put the visitors in control with their first goals of the season
articles.body:
Renee Slegers' side had put themselves in a commanding position thanks to both Alessia Russo and Georgia Stanway notching their first goals of the season.

However Clara Mateo and a spot kick from Maeline Mendy after Williamson had picked up the ball from a goal kick, saw the hosts turn the game around and snatch a point from the tie.

Pressure had been mounting on Slegers before the game with Arsenal picking up just one win from their opening four Women's Super League games.

Their main issue had been a lack of firepower in front of goal - and they were toothless for much of the first 45 minutes. That was until Russo combined with Stanway before rediscovering her clinical edge with a fine finish from the edge of the box.

Shortly after the break, it was Stanway's turn to celebrate. The former Bayern Munich midfielder was found unmarked inside the six-yard box and smashed home a volley to net her first goal since joining the club in the summer.

At that point, it seemed like there was only one winner. However, Arsenal failed to push the initiative in search for a third and were made to pay. First, Paris captain Mateo broke away on the counter before rounding past goalkeeper Misa and slotting into an empty net.

Then, with three minutes of normal time remaining, disaster struck. Having won a goal kick, Misa passed the ball to Williamson, seemingly for the Lioness to take the kick herself.

However, the referee had blown the whistle to resume play, so when Williamson picked up the ball to put it into position for herself to restart the game, Iuliana Demetrescu pointed to the spot.

Substitute Mendy fired into the bottom corner to complete the comeback and salvage a point for the hosts, condemning Arsenal to another disappointing result.

Russo: We let Paris back in before penalty mistake

Arsenal striker Alessia Russo speaking with Disney+:

"No [I didn't see us not winning the game]. It was a mistake. Obviously it wasn't intended at all. It's football, sometimes things like that happen. Unfortunately, it wasn't ideal but we move on.

"We let them come back into the second half way before that moment. We are disappointed but there were some really good things tonight."

On moving one behind Fran Kirby's English record of Women's Champions League goals:

"I had no idea that was even a record. It's nice. I'm really happy to have scored tonight because it's been a bit of a tough period. I'll just keep working hard and see what happens. Most importantly we keep building for Sunday and then the rest of the Champions League."
